title: 1RB0LC_1RC1RA_1RD0RF_0LE---_1LA1LE_0RA1LD: the excursion of the 00 return is a new pulse (Lean)
text: After a 00 pulse, mode A at a 011 word starts an ordinary pulse to the next defect; with a run of 1s there it takes three and returns in mode E (Lean, kernel only). So the return is recursive. All 21 return rules occur on the run from blank tape.
